title_zh: 特朗普与习近平通电话，确认尊重“一个中国”政策
title_en: Trump and Xi Speak by Phone and Affirm Respect for the One China Policy
summary_zh: 白宫纪要称，特朗普与习近平进行了长时间、友好的电话交谈。应习近平请求，特朗普同意尊重美国的“一个中国”政策；双方还邀请对方访问本国。
summary_en: The White House said that Donald Trump and Xi Jinping held a lengthy and cordial telephone conversation. At Xi’s request, Trump agreed to honor the U.S. “one China” policy, and both leaders extended invitations to visit each other’s countries.

title_zh: 特朗普与习近平在海湖庄园举行首次面对面会晤
title_en: Trump and Xi Hold Their First Face-to-Face Meeting at Mar-a-Lago
summary_zh: 特朗普在佛罗里达州海湖庄园接待习近平。双方讨论双边关系、贸易失衡和朝鲜半岛局势。特朗普会后表示，双方进行了深入会谈，双边关系取得进展。
summary_en: Donald Trump hosted Xi Jinping at Mar-a-Lago in Florida. They discussed bilateral relations, trade imbalances, and the Korean Peninsula. Trump said the talks had made progress.

title_zh: 中美公布“百日计划”初步成果
title_en: U.S. and China Announce Initial Results of the 100-Day Action Plan
summary_zh: 中美公布海湖庄园会晤后“百日计划”的初步成果，涉及牛肉、熟制禽肉、液化天然气、金融服务、电子支付和生物技术产品审查等。
summary_en: The United States and China announced initial results from the 100-Day Action Plan, covering beef, cooked poultry, liquefied natural gas, financial services, electronic payments, and biotechnology reviews.

sources.name_en: U.S. Department of Commerce joint release

title_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室启动对华“301调查”
title_en: USTR Launches a Section 301 Investigation into China
summary_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室依据《1974年贸易法》第301条，对中国在技术转让、知识产权和创新方面的政策与做法展开调查，为后续关税措施提供政策和法律基础。
summary_en: USTR initiated a Section 301 investigation into China’s policies and practices relating to technology transfer, intellectual property, and innovation. The investigation later formed the basis for U.S. tariff actions.

sources.name_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室：Section 301 China

title_zh: 特朗普在北京与习近平举行扩大双边会晤
title_en: Trump and Xi Hold an Expanded Bilateral Meeting in Beijing
summary_zh: 特朗普访华期间与习近平举行扩大双边会晤，讨论经贸、朝鲜半岛、军事沟通、执法合作和高层对话机制。特朗普提出改变对华贸易政策，习近平强调合作并妥善处理分歧。
summary_en: During Trump’s state visit to China, the leaders discussed trade, the Korean Peninsula, military communication, law-enforcement cooperation, and dialogue mechanisms. Trump called for changes to U.S. trade policy, while Xi emphasized cooperation and managing differences.

title_zh: 美国公布对华“301调查”主要结论
title_en: U.S. Releases Key Findings of the Section 301 Investigation into China
summary_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室认定，中国在技术转让、知识产权和创新政策方面的部分做法对美国商业造成负担，并建议采取关税和其他措施。
summary_en: USTR concluded that certain Chinese policies and practices relating to technology transfer, intellectual property, and innovation burdened U.S. commerce and recommended further action, including tariffs.

sources.name_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室：Section 301 China

title_zh: 美国对约340亿美元中国商品加征25%关税
title_en: U.S. Imposes 25% Tariffs on Approximately $34 Billion of Chinese Goods
summary_zh: 美国开始对818个税目、约340亿美元中国进口商品加征25%关税。中国随后采取对等关税反制，贸易摩擦公开升级。
summary_en: The United States began imposing an additional 25% tariff on 818 tariff lines covering approximately $34 billion in Chinese imports. China announced equivalent retaliatory tariffs.

sources.name_en: Office of the U.S. Trade Representative

title_zh: 美国对约160亿美元中国商品加征25%关税
title_en: U.S. Imposes 25% Tariffs on Approximately $16 Billion of Chinese Goods
summary_zh: 美国执行第二批对华关税措施，涉及约160亿美元进口商品和279个税目，税率为25%。中国同步对约160亿美元美国商品采取反制措施。
summary_en: The United States implemented a second tranche of Section 301 tariffs covering approximately $16 billion in Chinese imports and 279 tariff lines. China announced corresponding countermeasures.

sources.name_en: Office of the U.S. Trade Representative

title_zh: 美国对约2000亿美元中国商品加征首轮关税
title_en: U.S. Imposes Initial Tariffs on Approximately $200 Billion of Chinese Goods
summary_zh: 美国对约2000亿美元中国商品开始征收10%的额外关税，并公布未来可能提高至25%的安排。中国随后对约600亿美元美国商品采取反制关税。
summary_en: The United States began imposing a 10% additional tariff on approximately $200 billion of Chinese imports and announced a possible later increase to 25%. China responded with tariffs on approximately $60 billion of U.S. goods.

sources.name_en: Office of the U.S. Trade Representative

title_zh: 特朗普与习近平在布宜诺斯艾利斯举行工作晚宴
title_en: Trump and Xi Hold a Working Dinner in Buenos Aires
summary_zh: 二十国集团峰会期间，两国领导人举行工作晚宴。白宫称，特朗普同意暂缓部分关税上调，双方将在90天内讨论经贸议题；白宫还称习近平同意将芬太尼列为受管制物质。
summary_en: During the G20 summit, Trump and Xi held a working dinner. The White House said Trump agreed to delay certain tariff increases and that the sides would negotiate within 90 days. It also said Xi agreed to designate fentanyl as a controlled substance.

title_zh: 美国将约2000亿美元中国商品关税提高至25%
title_en: U.S. Raises Tariffs on Approximately $200 Billion of Chinese Goods to 25%
summary_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室宣布，将此前对约2000亿美元中国商品征收的关税从10%提高至25%，并启动对更多中国进口商品加征关税的程序。
summary_en: USTR announced that tariffs on approximately $200 billion of Chinese imports would rise from 10% to 25% and began a process to consider tariffs on additional Chinese imports.

sources.name_en: Office of the U.S. Trade Representative

title_zh: 华为及68家关联企业被列入美国实体清单
title_en: Huawei and 68 Affiliates Are Added to the U.S. Entity List
summary_zh: 美国商务部将华为及68家非美国关联企业列入实体清单。向相关实体出口、再出口或境内转移受美国《出口管理条例》管辖的物项须申请许可证，原则上按“推定拒绝”审查。
summary_en: The U.S. Commerce Department added Huawei and 68 non-U.S. affiliates to the Entity List. Exports, reexports, and in-country transfers of items subject to the Export Administration Regulations required a license, generally reviewed under a presumption of denial.

title_zh: 特朗普与习近平在大阪举行会晤并重启贸易谈判
title_en: Trump and Xi Meet in Osaka and Resume Trade Talks
summary_zh: 二十国集团大阪峰会期间，两国领导人同意继续贸易谈判。特朗普表示，美国暂缓对更多中国商品加征关税，并称美国企业可在不涉及重大国家安全风险的情况下向华为销售部分产品。
summary_en: At the G20 summit in Osaka, Trump and Xi agreed to resume trade negotiations. Trump said the United States would delay additional tariffs and that U.S. companies could sell certain products to Huawei where no major national-security risk was involved.

title_zh: 美国实施List 4A对华关税
title_en: U.S. Implements List 4A Tariffs on Chinese Goods
summary_zh: 美国开始对List 4A所列中国商品加征关税，涵盖服装、鞋类、消费品、农业产品等。税率后来提高至15%，并在第一阶段经贸协议生效后降至7.5%。
summary_en: The United States began imposing List 4A tariffs on Chinese goods, including apparel, footwear, consumer products, and agricultural goods. The rate was later raised to 15% and reduced to 7.5% after the Phase One agreement took effect.

title_zh: 美国《香港人权与民主法案》签署成法
title_en: The Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act Is Signed into Law
summary_zh: 特朗普签署《香港人权与民主法案》。该法要求美国政府定期评估香港自治状况，并授权对被认定应为香港人权问题承担责任的人员采取制裁和签证限制。
summary_en: President Trump signed the Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act. The law requires periodic U.S. assessments of Hong Kong’s autonomy and authorizes sanctions and visa restrictions against persons held responsible for human-rights abuses in Hong Kong.

title_zh: 中美签署第一阶段经贸协议
title_en: U.S. and China Sign the Phase One Economic and Trade Agreement
summary_zh: 协议涉及知识产权、技术转让、农业、金融服务、汇率和争端解决等内容。中国承诺增加采购美国商品和服务；美国调整部分对华关税，但未取消全部既有关税。
summary_en: The agreement covered intellectual property, technology transfer, agriculture, financial services, currency matters, and dispute resolution. China committed to additional purchases of U.S. goods and services, while the United States modified some tariffs without removing all existing duties.

sources.name_en: Office of the U.S. Trade Representative

title_zh: 第一阶段协议生效，部分美国对华关税下调
title_en: Phase One Agreement Takes Effect and Some U.S. Tariffs on China Are Reduced
summary_zh: 第一阶段协议生效。美国将List 4A商品的额外关税从15%下调至7.5%，并无限期暂停原计划对部分List 4B商品实施的关税。
summary_en: The Phase One agreement entered into force. The United States reduced the additional tariff on List 4A goods from 15% to 7.5% and indefinitely suspended certain tariffs scheduled for List 4B goods.

sources.name_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室：Phase One

title_zh: 美国通过《香港自治法》并发布香港相关行政令
title_en: U.S. Enacts the Hong Kong Autonomy Act and Issues an Executive Order on Hong Kong
summary_zh: 特朗普签署《香港自治法》，并发布第13936号行政令。美国政府开始取消香港与中国大陆之间的部分特殊待遇，并建立针对相关个人、实体和金融机构的制裁工具。
summary_en: President Trump signed the Hong Kong Autonomy Act and issued Executive Order 13936. The United States began removing certain preferential distinctions between Hong Kong and mainland China and established sanctions tools targeting relevant persons, entities, and financial institutions.

title_zh: 中美互相关闭休斯敦和成都总领馆
title_en: The U.S. and China Close Their Consulates in Houston and Chengdu
summary_zh: 美国要求中国关闭驻休斯敦总领馆，称此举旨在保护知识产权和私人信息。中国随后要求美国关闭驻成都总领馆。双方领事馆关闭标志着双边外交关系进一步恶化。
summary_en: The United States ordered China to close its Consulate General in Houston, citing the protection of intellectual property and private information. China subsequently ordered the closure of the U.S. Consulate General in Chengdu, further worsening bilateral relations.

title_zh: 中芯国际及其他中国实体被列入美国实体清单
title_en: SMIC and Other Chinese Entities Are Added to the U.S. Entity List
summary_zh: 美国商务部将中芯国际及其他中国实体列入实体清单，限制美国企业向相关实体出口受美国出口管制的技术和设备。美国方面称这些实体与中国军民融合和军事活动有关。
summary_en: The U.S. Commerce Department added SMIC and other Chinese entities to the Entity List, restricting exports of controlled U.S. technology and equipment. The United States cited alleged links to China’s military-civil fusion and military activities.

sources.name_zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局
sources.name_en: U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security

title_zh: 美国将中国在新疆的行为认定为“种族灭绝”和“反人类罪”
title_en: U.S. Determines China’s Actions in Xinjiang Constitute Genocide and Crimes Against Humanity
summary_zh: 国务卿蓬佩奥宣布，美国认定中国政府在新疆对维吾尔族和其他少数民族实施了种族灭绝和反人类罪。中国政府否认相关指控。
summary_en: Secretary of State Mike Pompeo announced that the United States had determined that the Chinese government committed genocide and crimes against humanity against Uyghurs and other ethnic minorities in Xinjiang. China rejected the allegations.

title_zh: 中美在安克雷奇举行高层会谈
title_en: U.S. and China Hold High-Level Talks in Anchorage
summary_zh: 布林肯、沙利文与杨洁篪、王毅在阿拉斯加举行会谈。双方在公开发言中就新疆、香港、台湾、人权、网络安全、经济胁迫和国际秩序表达明显分歧。
summary_en: Antony Blinken and Jake Sullivan met with Yang Jiechi and Wang Yi in Anchorage. Their public opening remarks revealed sharp differences over Xinjiang, Hong Kong, Taiwan, human rights, cybersecurity, economic coercion, and the international order.

sources.name_en: U.S. Department of State meeting transcript

title_zh: 美国副国务卿舍曼在天津会见王毅
title_en: Deputy Secretary Sherman Meets Wang Yi in Tianjin
summary_zh: 美国副国务卿温迪·舍曼访问天津，与王毅会面。双方讨论双边关系、台湾、网络安全、人权以及保持沟通渠道等问题。
summary_en: Deputy Secretary of State Wendy Sherman visited Tianjin and met with Wang Yi. The talks covered bilateral relations, Taiwan, cybersecurity, human rights, and maintaining communication channels.

title_zh: 拜登与习近平举行视频会晤
title_en: Biden and Xi Hold a Virtual Meeting
summary_zh: 拜登与习近平讨论双边竞争、台湾、人权、经贸、气候变化和全球能源。拜登强调建立“常识性护栏”、保持沟通，避免竞争演变为冲突。
summary_en: Biden and Xi discussed bilateral competition, Taiwan, human rights, trade, climate change, and global energy. Biden emphasized “common-sense guardrails” and open communication to prevent competition from turning into conflict.

title_zh: 美国《维吾尔强迫劳动预防法》签署成法
title_en: The Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act Is Signed into Law
summary_zh: 美国签署《维吾尔强迫劳动预防法》，对全部或部分在新疆开采、生产或制造的商品建立可反驳推定，原则上推定其使用强迫劳动生产。
summary_en: The United States enacted the Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act, creating a rebuttable presumption that goods mined, produced, or manufactured wholly or partly in Xinjiang were made with forced labor.

sources.name_zh: 美国海关与边境保护局

title_zh: 美国众议院议长佩洛西访问台湾
title_en: U.S. House Speaker Pelosi Visits Taiwan
summary_zh: 众议院议长南希·佩洛西访问台湾并与台湾方面会面。北京强烈反对访问，随后在台湾周边举行大规模军事演训，并暂停或中断部分中美沟通机制。
summary_en: House Speaker Nancy Pelosi visited Taiwan and met with Taiwan’s authorities. Beijing strongly opposed the visit and subsequently conducted large-scale military exercises around Taiwan while suspending or interrupting several communication mechanisms with Washington.

sources.name_zh: 美国众议院议长办公室历史资料
sources.name_en: Office of the Speaker historical materials

title_zh: 中国在台湾周边举行大规模军事演训
title_en: China Holds Large-Scale Military Exercises Around Taiwan
summary_zh: 佩洛西访台后，中国人民解放军在台湾周边多个海空域开展军事演训。美国及七国集团反对以访问为借口进行军事升级，并呼吁维护台海和平与稳定。
summary_en: Following Pelosi’s visit, the People’s Liberation Army conducted military exercises in multiple areas around Taiwan. The United States and G7 opposed military escalation and called for peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait.

sources.name_zh: 美国国务院发布的G7声明
sources.name_en: G7 statement published by the U.S. Department of State

title_zh: 美国发布对华先进计算和半导体出口管制规则
title_en: U.S. Issues Export Controls on Advanced Computing and Semiconductors to China
summary_zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局对先进计算芯片、超级计算机用途、半导体制造设备和部分美国人员支持活动设置新的出口许可要求，规则分阶段生效。
summary_en: The U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security imposed new licensing requirements on advanced computing chips, supercomputer end uses, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, and certain forms of U.S.-person support. The rules took effect in stages.

title_zh: 拜登与习近平在巴厘岛会晤
title_en: Biden and Xi Meet in Bali
summary_zh: 二十国集团峰会期间，拜登与习近平面对面会晤，讨论台湾、乌克兰、气候变化、卫生和粮食安全及战略风险，并同意加强高层沟通、安排布林肯访华。
summary_en: Biden and Xi met on the sidelines of the G20 summit. They discussed Taiwan, Ukraine, climate change, health and food security, and strategic risks, and agreed to strengthen high-level communication and arrange Blinken’s visit to China.

title_zh: 中国高空气球事件导致布林肯推迟访华
title_en: Chinese High-Altitude Balloon Incident Leads Blinken to Postpone China Visit
summary_zh: 美国发现中国高空气球进入美国领空后，国务卿布林肯推迟访华。布林肯称事件侵犯美国主权；中国方面称气球是偏离航线的民用气象飞艇。
summary_en: After detecting a Chinese high-altitude balloon in U.S. airspace, Secretary Blinken postponed his planned visit to China. Blinken called the incident a violation of U.S. sovereignty, while China said the balloon was a civilian meteorological airship blown off course.

sources.name_en: U.S. Department of State press briefing

title_zh: 布林肯访问北京并会见习近平
title_en: Blinken Visits Beijing and Meets Xi Jinping
summary_zh: 国务卿布林肯访问北京并会见习近平、王毅和秦刚，讨论沟通、台湾、乌克兰、经贸、禁毒、人权和气候等议题。访问恢复高层外交接触，但未解决核心分歧。
summary_en: Secretary Blinken visited Beijing and met with Xi Jinping, Wang Yi, and Qin Gang. They discussed communication, Taiwan, Ukraine, economic practices, counternarcotics, human rights, and climate. The visit restored high-level contact but did not resolve core disputes.

sources.name_zh: 美国国务院：布林肯访华资料
sources.name_en: U.S. Department of State: Blinken’s China visit

title_zh: 拜登与习近平在伍德赛德会晤
title_en: Biden and Xi Meet in Woodside
summary_zh: 两国领导人在加州伍德赛德会晤，同意恢复高层军事沟通、推动芬太尼禁毒合作并建立政府间人工智能安全对话；还讨论了台湾、南海、乌克兰和人员往来。
summary_en: Biden and Xi met in Woodside, California. They agreed to resume high-level military communication, restart counternarcotics cooperation focused on fentanyl, and establish government-to-government discussions on AI safety. They also discussed Taiwan, the South China Sea, Ukraine, and people-to-people ties.

title_zh: 拜登与习近平通电话
title_en: Biden and Xi Hold a Phone Call
summary_zh: 拜登与习近平通电话，回顾禁毒、军事沟通、人工智能风险和气候合作，并提出台海、南海、贸易政策、中国对俄罗斯国防工业基础的支持及先进技术安全等问题。
summary_en: Biden and Xi reviewed counternarcotics, military communication, AI risks, and climate cooperation. Biden raised Taiwan, the South China Sea, trade practices, China’s support for Russia’s defense industrial base, and advanced-technology security.

title_zh: 美国宣布提高部分中国战略产品关税
title_en: U.S. Announces Higher Tariffs on Selected Chinese Strategic Products
summary_zh: 拜登政府宣布提高中国电动汽车、半导体、太阳能电池、电池、关键矿产和医疗用品等战略产品的关税，措施源于对301关税的四年期审查。
summary_en: The Biden administration announced higher tariffs on selected Chinese strategic products, including electric vehicles, semiconductors, solar cells, batteries, critical minerals, and medical products, following the four-year review of Section 301 tariffs.

sources.name_en: Office of the U.S. Trade Representative

title_zh: 沙利文在北京会见习近平
title_en: Sullivan Meets Xi Jinping in Beijing
summary_zh: 美国国家安全顾问沙利文在北京会见习近平，并与王毅等中国官员会谈。双方讨论落实伍德赛德共识、禁毒、军事沟通、人工智能安全、台湾、乌克兰和南海问题。
summary_en: National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan met with Xi Jinping in Beijing and held talks with Wang Yi and other officials. They discussed the Woodside understandings, counternarcotics, military communication, AI safety, Taiwan, Ukraine, and the South China Sea.

title_zh: 美国部分对华战略产品关税正式生效
title_en: Some U.S. Tariff Increases on Chinese Strategic Products Take Effect
summary_zh: 美国对中国电动汽车、太阳能电池、钢铝、部分电池和关键矿产的关税提高措施开始生效。电动汽车税率提高至100%，太阳能电池提高至50%，部分产品税率为25%。
summary_en: Finalized tariff increases on selected Chinese strategic goods took effect. The tariff on Chinese electric vehicles rose to 100%, the rate on solar cells to 50%, and various batteries, metals, and critical minerals became subject to 25% rates.

sources.name_en: Office of the U.S. Trade Representative

title_zh: 中国宣布禁止向美国出口部分关键矿产
title_en: China Announces a Ban on Certain Critical-Mineral Exports to the U.S.
summary_zh: 中国商务部宣布加强对镓、锗、锑及相关双用途物项对美出口管制，并加强石墨相关出口的最终用户和最终用途审查。措施被视为对美国先进技术出口限制的回应。
summary_en: China announced tighter controls on exports of gallium, germanium, antimony, and related dual-use items to the United States, along with stricter end-user and end-use reviews for graphite-related exports.

sources.name_en: Ministry of Commerce of the People's Republic of China

title_zh: 美国对中国商品加征10%关税
title_en: U.S. Imposes an Additional 10% Tariff on Chinese Goods
summary_zh: 特朗普政府以芬太尼及前体化学品问题为由，对中国进口商品加征10%关税，并调整来自中国大陆和香港的小额包裹免税安排。中国表示反对并威胁反制。
summary_en: The Trump administration imposed an additional 10% tariff on Chinese imports, citing fentanyl and precursor chemicals. It also changed de minimis treatment for low-value shipments from mainland China and Hong Kong. China opposed the measures and threatened countermeasures.

sources.name_zh: 白宫行政令与事实清单
sources.name_en: White House executive order and fact sheet

title_zh: 美国将对华额外关税提高至20%，中国对美国农产品采取反制
title_en: U.S. Raises Additional Tariffs on China to 20%; China Retaliates Against U.S. Farm Products
summary_zh: 美国将2月实施的对华额外关税提高至20%。中国随后对鸡肉、小麦、玉米、棉花、大豆、肉类、水产品、水果、蔬菜和乳制品等美国农产品加征10%或15%关税。
summary_en: The United States raised its additional tariff on Chinese goods to 20%. China responded with 10% or 15% tariffs on U.S. agricultural products, including grains, cotton, soybeans, meat, seafood, fruits, vegetables, and dairy.

sources.name_zh: 中国财政部关税政策公告
sources.name_en: China Ministry of Finance tariff policy announcement

title_zh: 中美关税升级并扩大至出口管制和反制清单
title_en: U.S.-China Tariff Escalation Expands to Export Controls and Countermeasure Lists
summary_zh: 美国宣布对中国商品加征34%“对等关税”并进一步提高相关税率。中国对美国商品加征关税并提高至125%，同时限制部分稀土和双用途物项出口、将美国企业列入相关清单；美国对部分电子产品设置临时豁免。
summary_en: The United States announced a 34% reciprocal tariff on Chinese goods and later raised the rate. China raised tariffs on U.S. goods to 125%, restricted certain rare-earth and dual-use exports, and added U.S. companies to relevant lists. The United States also temporarily exempted certain electronics.

sources.name_zh: 白宫2025年关税行政令与声明
sources.name_en: White House 2025 tariff executive orders and statements

title_zh: 中美发布日内瓦经贸会谈联合声明
title_en: U.S. and China Issue a Joint Statement on Geneva Economic and Trade Talks
summary_zh: 中美同意暂时暂停和调整部分4月以来新增的关税措施，分别保留10%的相关额外税率，并建立由美国财长、贸易代表和中国国务院副总理参加的后续磋商机制。
summary_en: The United States and China agreed to temporarily suspend and modify certain additional tariffs imposed since April, retain a 10% component of the relevant additional tariffs, and establish a follow-up consultation mechanism.

title_zh: 中美在伦敦举行经贸磋商
title_en: U.S. and China Hold Economic and Trade Consultations in London
summary_zh: 中美代表在伦敦讨论落实日内瓦联合声明、关税、稀土出口许可、半导体限制和供应链稳定。双方随后宣布达成框架性理解。
summary_en: U.S. and Chinese officials discussed implementation of the Geneva statement, tariffs, rare-earth export licensing, semiconductor restrictions, and supply-chain stability in London. They subsequently announced an in-principle framework.

title_zh: 中美同意延长部分关税暂缓安排
title_en: U.S. and China Agree to Extend Some Tariff Suspensions
summary_zh: 在日内瓦、伦敦和斯德哥尔摩磋商后，中美同意自8月12日起继续暂缓部分新增关税90天，并保持经贸沟通机制。
summary_en: Following consultations in Geneva, London, and Stockholm, the United States and China agreed to extend the suspension of certain additional tariffs for another 90 days beginning August 12 and continue economic and trade consultations.

sources.name_zh: 白宫斯德哥尔摩联合声明

title_zh: 中国扩大稀土及电池材料出口管制，美国威胁提高关税
title_en: China Expands Export Controls on Rare Earths and Battery Materials; U.S. Threatens Higher Tariffs
summary_zh: 中国商务部扩大对稀土、永磁材料、锂离子电池材料和石墨负极材料的出口管制。特朗普随后威胁对中国商品加征更高关税并实施新的软件出口管制。
summary_en: China expanded export controls on rare-earth materials, permanent magnets, lithium-ion battery materials, and graphite anode materials. President Trump subsequently threatened higher tariffs on Chinese imports and new export controls on critical software.

sources.name_en: Ministry of Commerce of the People's Republic of China

title_zh: 特朗普与习近平在釜山会晤
title_en: Trump and Xi Meet in Busan
summary_zh: 特朗普与习近平在韩国釜山会晤，讨论关税、芬太尼前体、稀土、农业采购、半导体供应链、港口费用和出口管制。白宫称达成阶段性贸易安排；中方称达成共识并将履行国内审批程序。
summary_en: Trump and Xi met in Busan, South Korea, to discuss tariffs, fentanyl precursors, rare earths, agricultural purchases, semiconductor supply chains, port fees, and export controls. The White House described an interim trade arrangement, while China said consensus had been reached subject to domestic procedures.

title_zh: 白宫公布釜山会晤后的经贸安排
title_en: White House Announces Economic and Trade Arrangements Following the Busan Meeting
summary_zh: 白宫称，美国将降低部分芬太尼相关关税、暂停实体清单关联企业的50%持股规则并延长部分关税排除；中国将暂停部分稀土出口管制、调整对美农产品反制措施并扩大农业采购。具体承诺应分别注明双方来源。
summary_en: The White House said the United States would reduce certain fentanyl-related tariffs, suspend the Entity List affiliates rule, and extend some tariff exclusions. It said China would suspend certain rare-earth controls, adjust agricultural countermeasures, and expand purchases. Details should be attributed to each side’s sources.

title_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室启动对华强迫劳动和产能问题调查
title_en: USTR Launches Investigations into Forced Labor and Excess Capacity
summary_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室依据第301条启动两项调查，涉及强迫劳动进口禁令执行情况及制造业结构性产能过剩。中国批评调查是单边主义行为，并警告可能采取反制措施。
summary_en: USTR launched two Section 301 investigations concerning enforcement of forced-labor import prohibitions and structural excess capacity in manufacturing. China criticized the investigations as unilateralism and warned that it might take countermeasures.

sources.name_en: Office of the U.S. Trade Representative

title_zh: 特朗普访问北京并与习近平会晤
title_en: Trump Visits Beijing and Meets Xi Jinping
summary_zh: 特朗普访问北京并与习近平会谈，讨论市场准入、农产品和能源采购、关税、投资机制和关键供应链。美方称双方原则上讨论扩大贸易和投资；中方强调加强沟通、稳定双边关系。
summary_en: Trump visited Beijing and met with Xi Jinping to discuss market access, agricultural and energy purchases, tariffs, investment mechanisms, and critical supply chains. The U.S. described discussions on expanded trade and investment, while China emphasized communication and stability.

sources.name_zh: 中国外交部或国务院会谈纪要（正式链接待补）
sources.name_en: Chinese Foreign Ministry or State Council readout (official link pending)

sources.name_zh: 白宫会谈纪要（正式链接待补）
sources.name_en: White House meeting readout (official link pending)

title_zh: 美国将多家中国科技企业列入“中国军事企业”名单
title_en: U.S. Adds Several Chinese Technology Companies to Its Chinese Military Companies List
summary_zh: 美国国防部更新中国军事企业名单，涉及阿里巴巴、百度、比亚迪、中远海运、中国移动和中国电信等。列入名单不自动等同于实体清单制裁，但可能影响政府合同、投资审查和企业声誉。
summary_en: The U.S. Department of Defense updated its list of Chinese military companies, including Alibaba, Baidu, BYD, COSCO Shipping, China Mobile, and China Telecom. Inclusion does not automatically impose Entity List sanctions but may affect federal contracts, investment screening, and corporate reputation.

sources.name_zh: 美国国防部相关公告（正式链接待补）
sources.name_en: U.S. Department of Defense notice (official link pending)

title_zh: 鲁比奥与王毅在马尼拉举行会谈
title_en: Rubio and Wang Yi Hold Talks in Manila
summary_zh: 美国国务卿鲁比奥与王毅在东盟外长会议期间举行会谈，讨论双边关系、台海、南海以及为可能的元首会晤铺路。双方支持维持沟通，但在台湾和地区安全问题上仍有分歧。
summary_en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Foreign Minister Wang Yi met on the sidelines of the ASEAN foreign ministers’ meeting. They discussed bilateral relations, the Taiwan Strait, the South China Sea, and preparations for a possible leaders’ meeting. They supported continued communication but remained divided on regional security.

sources.name_zh: 美国国务院会谈纪要（正式链接待补）
sources.name_en: U.S. Department of State readout (official link pending)

sources.name_zh: 中国外交部会谈纪要（正式链接待补）
sources.name_en: Chinese Foreign Ministry readout (official link pending)

title_zh: 美国对中国等经济体实施强迫劳动相关301关税
title_en: U.S. Imposes Forced-Labor-Related Section 301 Tariffs on China and Other Economies
summary_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室宣布对包括中国大陆和香港在内的经济体征收与强迫劳动进口禁令相关的额外关税。中国反对单边关税，并否认美国相关指控。
summary_en: USTR announced additional Section 301 duties related to forced-labor import prohibitions on economies including mainland China and Hong Kong. China opposed the unilateral tariffs and rejected U.S. allegations concerning forced labor.

sources.name_en: Office of the U.S. Trade Representative

title_zh: 美国限制外国制造的先进机器人和电力逆变器
title_en: U.S. Restricts Foreign-Made Advanced Robotics and Power Inverters
summary_zh: 美国联邦通信委员会将外国制造的先进机器人和电力逆变器列入受限制设备清单，新型号无法获得美国设备授权，因而不能在美国进口、销售或营销。中国批评此举扩大国家安全概念并打压中国企业。
summary_en: The FCC added foreign-made advanced robotic devices and power inverters to its Covered List. New models could not obtain U.S. equipment authorization and therefore could not be imported, marketed, or sold in the United States. China criticized the move as an abuse of national-security concepts.

title_zh: 美国将43家中国企业列入UFLPA实体清单
title_en: U.S. Adds 43 Chinese Companies to the UFLPA Entity List
summary_zh: 美国国土安全部将43家中国企业列入《维吾尔强迫劳动预防法》实体清单，涉及铝、棉花、铜、锂、医药等行业。相关商品适用强迫劳动可反驳推定。
summary_en: The Department of Homeland Security added 43 Chinese companies to the UFLPA Entity List, covering aluminum, cotton, copper, lithium, pharmaceuticals, and other sectors. Goods linked to the entities are subject to a rebuttable presumption of forced labor.

title_zh: 中国对美国企业、无人机和认证机构采取反制措施
title_en: China Takes Countermeasures Affecting U.S. Companies, Drones, and Certification Bodies
summary_zh: 中国商务部宣布限制向美国出口无人机及相关零部件，将数家美国企业列入反制清单，并限制办公设备、工厂检查和认证活动。中方称此举是对美国相关限制的回应。
summary_en: China announced restrictions on drone and component exports to the United States, added several U.S. companies to a countermeasures list, and imposed restrictions involving office equipment, factory inspections, and certification activities. China described the measures as a response to U.S. restrictions.

sources.name_en: Ministry of Commerce of the People's Republic of China

title_zh: 美国计划对中国商品加征产能相关关税
title_en: U.S. Reportedly Plans Capacity-Related Tariffs on Chinese Goods
summary_zh: 媒体报道，美国计划依据产能过剩调查对中国商品加征约7.5%的关税。该措施如实施，将与此前强迫劳动相关关税共同影响中国商品进入美国市场。正式纳入历史档案前应补充USTR最终公告。
summary_en: Media reports indicated that the United States was considering an additional tariff of approximately 7.5% on Chinese goods following an excess-capacity investigation. The measure should not be treated as final without a USTR announcement.

sources.name_zh: 媒体报道；USTR最终公告待补
sources.name_en: Media reports; final USTR notice pending

title_zh: 中美官员在纽约磋商经贸和人工智能合作
title_en: U.S. and Chinese Officials Discuss Trade and AI Cooperation in New York
summary_zh: 何立峰与贝森特、格里尔会面，为习近平访美作准备。双方据报道建立中美人工智能对话，并推动落实贸易委员会和投资委员会；正式纪要及部分成果仍待补充核实。
summary_en: He Lifeng met with Scott Bessent and Jamieson Greer ahead of Xi’s visit to Washington. The sides reportedly established a bilateral AI dialogue and advanced trade and investment boards; official readouts and some details remain to be verified.

sources.name_zh: 美国财政部正式纪要（链接待补）
中国国务院正式纪要（链接待补）
sources.name_en: Chinese State Council official readout (link pending)

title_zh: 美国财政部长称中美同意延长贸易缓和安排
title_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Says U.S. and China Agreed to Extend Trade Truce
summary_zh: 美国财政部长贝森特表示，中美同意将2025年釜山安排延长两个月，将原定2026年11月10日的期限推迟至2027年1月10日。中方当时未立即确认，页面应标注为美方宣布。
summary_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the United States and China had agreed to extend the 2025 Busan trade arrangement by two months, from November 10, 2026, to January 10, 2027. China had not immediately confirmed the extension.

sources.name_zh: 美国财政部或美国政府正式声明（链接待补）
sources.name_en: U.S. Treasury or U.S. government statement (link pending)

title_zh: 习近平访问华盛顿并与特朗普举行国事访问会晤
title_en: Xi Jinping Visits Washington for a State-Visit Meeting with Trump
summary_zh: 习近平访问华盛顿并与特朗普会谈，讨论贸易、人工智能、科技、农业、能源和双边关系管理。双方谈及青年交流和熊猫外交等人文议题；具体经贸成果仍需逐项核实。
summary_en: Xi Jinping visited Washington and held talks with Donald Trump on trade, AI, technology, agriculture, energy, and bilateral relations. Youth exchanges and panda diplomacy were also discussed; specific trade outcomes require verification.

sources.name_zh: 中国外交部会谈纪要（待补）

title_zh: 美国将三家中国生物科技企业列入UFLPA实体清单
title_en: U.S. Adds Three Chinese Biotechnology Companies to the UFLPA Entity List
summary_zh: 美国国土安全部将BGI Genomics、MGI Tech和Shenzhen BGI Technology列入UFLPA实体清单。美国方面指称相关企业协助建立和运营新疆监控基础设施；中方称指控毫无根据并表示将采取措施维护企业利益。
summary_en: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security added BGI Genomics, MGI Tech, and Shenzhen BGI Technology to the UFLPA Entity List. The U.S. alleged links to surveillance infrastructure in Xinjiang; China called the allegations baseless and said it would protect its companies’ interests.
